brief: A free, student-built timetable generator for VIT's FFCS registration. Friendly and made by a student, but precise enough to trust with a semester of slots.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, distinct from blue/green ed-tech, ties to the timetable grid.

concepts.name: Slot F
concepts.idea: An F built from timetable blocks, with one free slot in coral.
rationale: The blocks echo the cells of a timetable grid
Coral is the one accent, so the free slot is what you notice
Chunky blocks keep the F readable down to 16 px

recommendation: Slot F in coral on warm ink, reversed on warm dark.
